market_context: Gartner identifies interoperable connectivity, embedded AI, GenAI-enabled virtual assistants, and autonomous robotics as forces that will reshape smart home user experiences (per Gartner, https://www.gartner.com/en/documents/5810115).
Statista reports the United States generates the most smart home revenue, at US$20.1bn in 2026 (per Statista, https://www.statista.com/outlook/cmo/smart-home/worldwide/).

SafeHome.org's 2026 report highlights rising adoption of smart systems and millions of U.S. households investing in protection (per SafeHome.org, https://www.safehome.org/resources/home-security-industry-annual/).

SafeHome.org's 2026 report says Ring was the most popular home security camera brand, used by 43% of surveyed users (per SafeHome.org, https://www.safehome.org/resources/home-security-industry-annual/).
